title: Calculate Convolution Output Dimensions
description: Write a formula to compute the spatial output dimensions of a 2D convolutional layer given input size, kernel, padding, and stride.
problemStatement: In computer vision architecture design, determining layer spatial dimensions is critical. Implement a Python function `conv2d_output_dim(input_size: int, kernel_size: int, padding: int, stride: int) -> int` that calculates: `floor((input_size - kernel_size + 2 * padding) / stride) + 1`.
hints: Use integer division // to obtain the floor value.
expectedOutput: Integer representing the spatial height/width after convolution.
solutionCode:
def conv2d_output_dim(input_size: int, kernel_size: int, padding: int, stride: int) -> int:
    return ((input_size - kernel_size + 2 * padding) // stride) + 1
